edits.english: The mishna teaches: Yosef ben Ḥoni says: Other offerings that are slaughtered for the sake of a Pesach offering or a ḥatat offering are unfit. Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Yosef ben Ḥoni and Rabbi Eliezer said the same thing, i.e., Rabbi Eliezer agrees with Yosef ben Ḥoni.

edits.hebrew: אמרו דבר אחד: that Rabbi Eliezer also disqualifies other offerings slaughtered for the sake of a Pesach offering at its designated time, or for the sake of a ḥatat offering all year round, and Rabbi Yoḥanan derives this from a baraita below.
